title: Analyst lens: Sanofi vaccines in Taiwan

products.name: Beyfortus
products.signal: RSV volume roughly doubled week on week, driven by a report of 16 infants infected in a cluster at a Changhua postpartum care centre within 20 days, plus parent posts on RSV protection in pregnancy and wanting antibodies for newborns at birth. No item names Beyfortus or states funding.
products.implication: Infant RSV is moving from niche to news, with postpartum care centres in focus. That invites questions from media, parents and policymakers about how newborns are protected and who pays, and the company has no visible voice yet.
products.action: Prepare a factual, non-promotional briefing on infant RSV burden and care-setting transmission for policy and clinical audiences. Ready a holding line for media queries on the cluster, and listen to neonatology and paediatric stakeholders on infection-control and prevention policy needs.
products.signal_zh: RSV聲量週增約一倍，主因為彰化產後護理之家20天內16名嬰兒群聚感染的報導，以及家長討論孕期RSV保護、希望新生兒出生即施打抗體的貼文。無任何內容提及Beyfortus或費用來源。
products.implication_zh: 嬰兒RSV正從小眾議題成為新聞焦點，產後護理之家備受關注，將引發媒體、家長及決策者對新生兒如何保護及由誰付費的提問，而公司目前尚無明顯發聲。
products.action_zh: 為政策與臨床對象準備事實性、非促銷性的嬰兒RSV疾病負擔及照護場所傳播簡報。備妥群聚事件的媒體回應口徑，並聽取新生兒科及兒科利害關係人對感染管制與預防政策的需求。

products.name: High-dose influenza vaccine
products.sub: Efluelda (菲優達), public enhanced flu programme for 65+ in long-term care
products.signal: High-dose and enhanced-flu volume fell sharply week on week as launch coverage faded. Two opinion columns framed the first enhanced flu batch as a super-aged-society strategy, and a fact-check found the public enhanced flu vaccine is not mRNA. Severity coverage stresses that older adults make up most severe cases; some top-up stories mention enhanced vaccines but do not say whether extra enhanced doses were ordered.
products.implication: The policy debate is turning from launch to evaluation and the ageing-society agenda, an opening for evidence dialogue. Rumours conflating enhanced flu vaccines with mRNA, and questions about the limited enhanced allocation amid high elderly severity, are live risks.
products.action: Prepare an evidence and rollout-learning pack for policymakers and advisers on enhanced vaccines in long-term care settings. Track CDC statements on whether top-ups include enhanced doses, and keep the fact-check findings ready for issue response with stakeholders.
who: Taiwan CDC and its immunisation advisory committee (ACIP)
products.sub_zh: Efluelda（菲優達），長照機構65歲以上公費加強型流感疫苗
products.signal_zh: 隨開打報導退燒，高劑量及加強型流感聲量週減明顯。兩篇評論專欄將首批加強型流感疫苗定位為超高齡社會策略，事實查核則確認公費加強型流感疫苗並非mRNA。重症報導強調重症多為長者；部分追加採購報導提及加強型疫苗，但未說明是否追加加強型劑量。
products.implication_zh: 政策討論正由開打轉向成效評估與高齡社會議程，為實證對話創造契機。將加強型流感疫苗與mRNA混為一談的謠言，以及長者重症偏高下加強型配額有限的質疑，皆為現存風險。
products.action_zh: 為決策者及顧問準備長照場域加強型疫苗的實證與推動經驗資料包。追蹤疾管署對追加採購是否含加強型疫苗的說明，並備妥事實查核結果，供與利害關係人進行議題回應。
who_zh: 疾管署及其預防接種諮詢委員會（ACIP）
衛生政策專欄作家及學者

products.name: Tdap booster
products.signal: Little this week: Tdap volume is very low (7 items vs 5 the week before), and the only related storyline, medical societies urging vaccines for chronic lung disease patients, saw no new items in the last 7 days. A widely engaged parent post on pregnancy vaccines mentions RSV, flu and COVID-19 but not Tdap.
products.implication: Tdap is absent from the pregnancy-vaccine conversation, which is currently framed around RSV, flu and COVID-19. There is no immediate issue, but the maternal agenda is being set without pertussis in it.
products.action: No reactive action needed. Keep monitoring, and maintain dialogue with obstetric and respiratory societies on including pertussis in maternal and chronic-disease immunisation discussions.
products.sub_zh: 百日咳保護，含孕期接種
products.signal_zh: 本週動態甚少：Tdap聲量極低（7則，前週5則），唯一相關議題「醫學會呼籲慢性肺病患者接種疫苗」近7天無新內容。一則互動熱烈的家長孕期疫苗貼文提及RSV、流感及COVID-19，但未提及Tdap。
products.implication_zh: Tdap缺席孕期疫苗討論，目前討論圍繞RSV、流感及COVID-19。雖無立即問題，但孕產婦議程正在形成，且未納入百日咳。
products.action_zh: 無需被動回應。持續監測，並與婦產科及呼吸道醫學會保持對話，推動將百日咳納入孕產婦及慢性病預防接種討論。

products.name: Novavax (Nuvaxovid) XFG COVID-19 vaccine
products.sub: Protein-based, distributed by Sanofi; public programme from Oct 19
products.signal: Taiwan CDC announced the Novavax public COVID-19 vaccine will be offered from October 19 and that additional Novavax doses are planned. Multiple outlets relayed the 'starts next week' message alongside top-up order coverage.
products.implication: The October 19 start is a concrete public-programme milestone that will draw questions on where and when it is available. General COVID-19 vaccine misinformation in posts is not Novavax-specific but could attach to any launch-week news.
products.action: Ensure launch-week readiness: align factual information with CDC and local health bureaus on availability and distribution timing, and confirm the adverse-event reporting and medical-information pathways. Prepare holding statements for supply or access questions without making product claims.
products.sub_zh: 蛋白質次單位疫苗，由Sanofi經銷；10月19日起納入公費
products.signal_zh: 疾管署宣布Novavax公費COVID-19疫苗自10月19日起提供，並規劃追加Novavax疫苗。多家媒體將「下週開打」訊息與追加採購報導一併轉載。
products.implication_zh: 10月19日開打為具體的公費計畫里程碑，將引發何時何地可接種的提問。貼文中的一般COVID-19疫苗錯誤訊息雖非針對Novavax，但可能附著於開打週的任何新聞。
products.action_zh: 確保開打週準備就緒：與疾管署及地方衛生局對齊供應與配送時程的事實資訊，並確認不良事件通報及醫藥資訊管道。準備供應或可近性問題的回應聲明，不做產品宣稱。

issues.title: Novavax public COVID-19 rollout begins
issues.note: Taiwan CDC set the start date. Expect questions on clinic availability, dose volumes and timing, plus any suspected adverse-event posts in launch week.
issues.note_zh: 疾管署已訂定開打日期。預期將有診所供應、劑量及時程的提問，以及開打週疑似不良事件貼文。

issues.title: Interim clinic stock gaps before top-up doses arrive
issues.note: Reports say the 474,000 added public doses arrive in early November. Meanwhile a user reports finding no flu vaccine left, and the second programme stage opens on 2026-11-02.
issues.title_zh: 追加疫苗到貨前診所暫時缺貨
issues.note_zh: 據報47.4萬劑追加公費疫苗11月初到貨。同時有用戶反映找不到流感疫苗，而計畫第二階段將於2026-11-02開打。

issues.title: Follow-up on infant RSV cluster and newborn protection
issues.note: The postpartum care centre cluster and parent posts on RSV antibodies may prompt media or legislative questions on infant RSV prevention and its funding.
issues.title_zh: 嬰兒RSV群聚與新生兒保護後續
issues.note_zh: 產後護理之家群聚及家長RSV抗體貼文，可能引發媒體或立法院對嬰兒RSV預防及經費的質詢。

self_pay.title: Self-pay mentioned, but no prices or stock detail
self_pay.note: Several guides and supply stories note that self-paid flu and COVID-19 options exist alongside the public programme, but none report prices, clinic stock levels or private demand.
self_pay.title_zh: 提及自費，但無價格或庫存細節
self_pay.note_zh: 數篇指南及供應報導指出，除公費計畫外另有自費流感及COVID-19疫苗選項，但均未報導價格、診所庫存或自費需求。

self_pay.title: Isolated stock-out report
self_pay.note: A single user post says no flu vaccine was left when they asked at a clinic; funding is not stated, so it is unclear whether this concerns public or self-pay supply.
self_pay.note_zh: 僅一則用戶貼文稱向診所詢問時流感疫苗已無庫存；未說明費用來源，無法判斷屬公費或自費供應。

self_pay.title: Nothing on enhanced flu, RSV antibodies or Tdap self-pay
self_pay.note: No items this week cover self-pay availability or pricing for enhanced flu vaccines, infant RSV antibodies or Tdap. A parent post on wanting RSV antibodies at birth does not say how they would be funded.
self_pay.title_zh: 加強型流感、RSV抗體及Tdap自費皆無相關內容
self_pay.note_zh: 本週無內容涉及加強型流感疫苗、嬰兒RSV抗體或Tdap的自費供應或價格。一則希望出生即施打RSV抗體的家長貼文，未說明費用來源。
